faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is Vocab Mate suitable for beginners?
faq.a1: Yes, absolutely! You can customize your CEFR target from A1 to C2. The system recommends words suited to your level.
faq.q2: How does FSRS help vocabulary retention?
faq.a2: FSRS models memory decay to schedule reviews at the exact optimal moment, helping you retain words 3x longer in less time.
faq.q3: How does the AI Tutor assist my learning?
faq.a3: AI Tutor creates interactive exercises from articles you read, provides smart hints, and explains nuances in real time.
faq.q4: Can I use Vocab Mate for free?
faq.a4: Yes! You can create a free account to read real-world news, look up AI definitions, and start AI Tutor sessions today.
